posts.title: Peace of mind
posts.description: I came across a short clip of Gary Vee on Mel Robbins’ podcast. I know Gary isn’t everyone’s cup of tea. But something he said has been rattling around in my head ever since. He has the audience. The businesses. The money. But he said the number one thing he has isn’t any of that. […]

posts.title: Loops
posts.description: Loops are magical. I’m trying to build a one-person business that can scale up customers without having to scale up head count. As such, I’ve been thinking a lot about loops lately. Not the kind you write in code. The kind that keep running whether you’re paying attention or not. For most of my career, […]

posts.title: Stretched thin
posts.description: I’ve noticed something about myself since I started working with AI agents. If I let it, it’s all-consuming. I give an agent a task. While it works, I start another. Then the first one finishes, and I’ve already thought of a third. There’s something about it that gets me into the zone. Every finished task […]
